title:
This executor is a {@link SynchronousPyExecutor} that {@link #execute}s a {@link Workflow}. If multiple vertices
are ready to run, this executor will run them in separate threads. It uses a
{@link ParallelSynchronousPyExecutionRepresentation} for its {@link WorkflowExecutionRepresentation} and a
{@link SimpleSynchronousPyRun} for its {@link WorkflowExecutorRun}.
name: ParallelSynchronousPyExecutor
